experience.text: Leading protocol architecture and infrastructure for people, AI agents, and robots. Building user-owned personal AI context, private payments, and a naming protocol for a Sui-derived chain.

Built a programmable agent runtime with a compiler and VM stack, and a browser IDE for deploying on-chain agents. Agents manage their own keys, funds, and memory. Also built Causal, an experience-memory engine with temporal graphs and hybrid retrieval.

Built a self-balancing peer-to-peer GPU network for LLM inference and PEFT/LoRA post-training, adapting Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1 for distributed execution. The app won a prize at the 2024 DMCC × Bybit hackathon.

Owned architecture and most of the code, and led three engineers and the executive team. Built validator-specific liquid staking across 150+ validator destinations and TenderSwap, which reached $10M in cumulative swap volume.
Built, operated, and open-sourced a GPU video-transcoding pool. The software was adopted by major Livepeer operators, including the official grants node.

An early engineering hire in a two-person protocol team. Co-designed probabilistic micropayments, owned the orchestrator/transcoder split, and guided the pre-launch Arbitrum migration through design and review. In 2024, built open-source Livepeer AI infrastructure for LLMs, video models, and object detection.

Established Emakina’s new blockchain business unit and led architecture, prototyping, and enterprise and government pre-sales. Delivered pilots in telco settlement, trade finance, identity, and supply-chain provenance. Won the Emakina Group Silver Innovation Award.
